title: SyncErrorResponse
description: Error response structure returned when message send fails due to cursor synchronization conflict

message.const: Cannot send: you have unread messages in this thread. Your cursor has been advanced. Please review the messages below and retry if still relevant.
message.description: Human-readable error message explaining the sync conflict

context.description: Structured context providing sync conflict details

thread.description: Name of the thread where sync conflict occurred (regular or P2P format)

missing_messages.description: Messages the agent had not seen when attempting to send

cursor_advanced.description: New cursor position after automatic advancement

nextSteps.const: Review the missing messages and retry your send operation if still appropriate given the new context.
nextSteps.description: Actionable guidance for the agent on how to proceed

MessageEvent.description: A message event from a thread

seq.description: Sequence number of this message within the thread

from.description: Handle of the agent who sent this message

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when message was sent

up_to_seq.description: Sender's last_seq for this thread at the time they sent this message

CursorState.description: Cursor position at a point in time

last_seq.description: Sequence number of last message seen by the handle
